status.scope: Selected public foundations and algorithm declarations; actual imported kernel types with readable and pp.all views, and exact Expr DAG round trips.
status.limits: A selected API reference, not an exhaustive generated index of every declaration. Exporting types is separate from production proof and transitive-axiom verification.

contracts.title: Finite accepted and Boolean-witness counts
contracts.fixed_parameters: Finite witness types and Boolean acceptance predicates.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Accepted elements, exact Boolean witness length, and acceptance predicate.
contracts.input_promises: Fintype witnesses; any bijections or unique-padding hypotheses appear in the full theorem type.
contracts.outputs: Natural-valued finite indicator sums, product identities, and exact unique-false-padding invariance.
contracts.cost: Finite cardinality semantics; no verifier runtime is supplied by these identities.
contracts.limits: Ignored independent bits multiply counts and do not provide a parsimonious extension.

contracts.title: Faithful framed binary encodings
contracts.runtime_inputs: Binary lists and lists of framed binary values.
contracts.outputs: Injective framing, exact encoded-length identities, and decoding round trips.
contracts.cost: Encoding identities and lengths; a codec round trip alone does not prove a polynomial-time converter.
contracts.limits: Concrete execution bounds require the separate machine layer.

contracts.title: Finite-machine polynomial time and composition
contracts.fixed_parameters: Explicit input/output encodings over finite alphabets.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Functions and concrete finite TM2 computers, with polynomial transition bounds.
contracts.outputs: FP membership, composed actual machines, exact transition composition and encoded-output bounds.
contracts.cost: Transition counts on the complete encoded input; the second computation is charged at the derived first-output length.
contracts.limits: These contracts concern the stated encodings and machine model.

contracts.title: Natural-valued polynomial witness counting
contracts.runtime_inputs: Natural-valued functions, polynomial witness lengths, and actual finite-machine verifiers.
contracts.input_promises: Each Boolean witness has exactly the polynomial length in the instance's encoded length.
contracts.outputs: SharpPWitness, InSharpP, witness-count growth bounds and constant examples.
contracts.cost: Verifier runtime is polynomial in the encoded instance/witness pair.
contracts.limits: The verifier accepts witnesses; it does not itself produce the count. Complex-weighted evaluation is a separate output contract.

contracts.title: Implemented parsimonious reductions
contracts.fixed_parameters: Explicit source/target instance and natural-answer encodings.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Actual polynomial-time instance maps with pointwise equality of counts.
contracts.outputs: Composition, encoded-output bounds, downward FP transport and forward class-relative hardness transport.
contracts.cost: Composition retains concrete machine transition bounds and charges intermediate output lengths.
contracts.limits: Hardness transport is conditional and does not separate complexity classes. SharpP membership transport has its own verifier construction.

contracts.title: Ordered weighted constraints and open partitions
contracts.fixed_parameters: Signature language, domain, coefficient semiring and boundary/hidden types.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Ordered occurrence lists and ordered scopes, with a boundary assignment.
contracts.outputs: Language, occurrence and open-instance types and finite hidden-assignment partition sums.
contracts.resources: Repeated occurrences and ports, nullary/zero signatures, and isolated variables remain explicit.
contracts.cost: Mathematical partition semantics; no machine or bit-runtime contract.

contracts.title: Gluing and substitution of weighted gadgets
contracts.runtime_inputs: Open instances, compatible interfaces and realizing gadgets.
contracts.input_promises: Resource/realization and finite-type assumptions are explicit in each full type.
contracts.outputs: Exact partition equalities for gluing, disjoint union and substitution.
contracts.cost: Semantic identities; representation and machine costs are separate.
contracts.limits: An instance equality does not grant unlisted resources to a fixed language.

contracts.title: Witness and accepting-path SharpP presentations
contracts.runtime_inputs: Natural-valued functions on Boolean lists.
contracts.outputs: Equivalence of witness-verifier membership and accepting-path membership.
contracts.cost: Actual verifier/machine translations are provided by the imported bridge.
contracts.limits: The public equivalence uses binary inputs and retains the source machine conventions.

contracts.title: Counting Cook-Levin to independent NOR instances
contracts.fixed_parameters: Standard binary witness counting and the target instance codec.
contracts.runtime_inputs: SharpP witness verifiers and source instances.
contracts.outputs: Target SharpP membership and implemented count-preserving reductions to independent NOR counting.
contracts.cost: The compiler and verifier are actual finite polynomial-time machines over their declared encodings.
contracts.limits: The count-preserving padding is uniquely determined; unrestricted unused witness bits are not introduced.

contracts.title: Measured Lagrange interpolation
contracts.runtime_inputs: A degree bound m, exactly m+1 nodes, and their sample values.
contracts.input_promises: Node distinctness and degree/sample restrictions appear in the specification theorem.
contracts.outputs: The executed value recovers coefficient m of a polynomial of degree at most m, with exact query and field-operation counts.
contracts.cost: The actual program uses m+1 sample queries and 2(m+1)^2 field operations. Constants, list construction and checked-frontend equality comparisons are outside this arithmetic model.
contracts.limits: Encoded bit runtime belongs to the separate fixed-field interpolation-machine layer.

contracts.title: Finite-stack Pfaffian evaluation
contracts.fixed_parameters: Represented number field and a rational basis.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Encoded grids/matrices of variable order with the declared representation validity.
contracts.outputs: Certified Pfaffian value, finite-stack polynomial computer, exact execution identity and FP membership.
contracts.cost: Polynomial runtime on the actual encoded matrix under the fixed field/basis representation.
contracts.limits: This is Pfaffian evaluation; planar counting applications require separate orientation, normalization and graph promises.
contracts.input_promises: The machine evaluates encoded grids; the independent pairing-Pfaffian correctness theorem assumes a square skew-symmetric matrix with zero diagonal, including empty and odd orders.

contracts.title: Whole-request Karp-Luby DNF approximation
contracts.fixed_parameters: Original finite uniform Boolean-tape model and deterministic Boolean-stack program.
contracts.runtime_inputs: DNF formula, rational accuracy/confidence parameters and a tape of the requested budget.
contracts.input_promises: Program.ValidRequest supplies the legal accuracy/confidence restrictions.
contracts.outputs: Actual clean rational-output halts, exact zero behavior, finite fair-tape relative-error probability and parameterized bounds.
contracts.cost: The actual whole-input transition and Primitive bounds charge encoded parameters and the requested random-bit budget.
contracts.limits: Probability is over the original finite uniform tape; it is not an unstated probabilistic-transition model.

contracts.title: Bucket elimination and open-partition bridge
contracts.runtime_inputs: Ordered factors, boundary assignment and a supplied complete variable order.
contracts.input_promises: Finite domains and explicit completeness of the elimination order.
contracts.outputs: Actual bucket-elimination result equals the original open partition.
contracts.cost: This bridge proves execution correctness; cached work and width bounds are separate refinements.
contracts.limits: The semantic equality is not a polynomial encoded-machine cost bound.

contracts.title: Prepared dense-table elimination
contracts.runtime_inputs: Stored finite-domain tables and a supplied complete elimination order.
contracts.outputs: Once-only input preparation, cached evaluator and exact partition value.
contracts.cost: Returned observations retain declared layout, addressing, table-read, preparation and coefficient-work channels.
contracts.limits: Physical allocation, internal scope/assignment operations, coefficient bit costs and canonical-order construction are separate obligations.

contracts.title: Tree-decomposition-driven elimination
contracts.runtime_inputs: Stored factors and a supplied tree decomposition of their actual primal graph.
contracts.outputs: Constructed-order elimination, partition correctness and coefficient-addition bounds depending on width.
contracts.cost: Accumulated declared logical work is bounded using the supplied decomposition and retained occurrence/port counts.
contracts.limits: Decomposition search/conversion costs, physical storage and coefficient bit costs are not included.

contracts.title: Product-factor elimination
contracts.fixed_parameters: Commutative coefficient semiring and the Boolean factor vocabulary.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Explicit variable count and ordered scalar, unary, equality and disequality occurrences.
contracts.outputs: The executed evaluator and annotated run equal the public S1 partition.
contracts.cost: Coefficient additions/multiplications and scan/rewrite factor visits have explicit bounds.
contracts.limits: Arithmetic counts exclude coefficient bit lengths, input compilation and finite-address operations. A separate fixed-palette machine frontend supplies a narrower bit-runtime contract.

contracts.title: Affine partition and bytecode executor
contracts.runtime_inputs: Boolean affine support, quadratic phase, scale and initial stack.
contracts.outputs: Semantic affine evaluation, compiled scalar bytecode and actual stack execution agree with the affine partition.
contracts.cost: Compiler transition and emitted-code-size bounds are separate from algebraic coefficient interpretation.
contracts.limits: S1 assembly and algebraic interpretation are noncomputable. The fixed-language bit machine has its own explicit input/output representation.

contracts.title: Fixed-language affine bit machine
contracts.fixed_parameters: A finite Boolean affine family, arity layout and original coefficient-field presentation.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Validated original raw-network encodings.
contracts.outputs: The source finite polynomial-time solver and FP membership with its original output codec.
contracts.cost: Actual finite-machine polynomial runtime for the fixed family; the source also states a same-run Primitive-cost bound.
contracts.limits: No uniform polynomial evaluator is claimed when the signature language varies as input.

contracts.title: Holographic invariance and boundary covariance
contracts.fixed_parameters: Finite domain, commutative coefficient semiring and compatible transformation kernels.
contracts.runtime_inputs: Explicit coordinate actions and paired-stub open or closed networks.
contracts.input_promises: Cancellation/inverse directions and edge compatibility are hypotheses in each full type.
contracts.outputs: Coordinate-action cancellation, closed partition invariance and open boundary covariance.
contracts.cost: Finite-domain algebraic identities; optional fixed-table machines carry their own narrower execution contracts.
contracts.limits: Open boundary covariance retains its transformation directions; invariance cannot be substituted indiscriminately.

contracts.title: Compiled POG counting and weighted partitions
contracts.runtime_inputs: CNF formula, compiled POG, root literal and optional complementary ring weights.
contracts.input_promises: Partitionedness, declared-variable coverage and original PropFun formula equivalence.
contracts.outputs: Original array counter/ring evaluator equals the corresponding S1 partition.
contracts.cost: Correctness bridge to the existing evaluator; no new parser/checker or machine complexity is asserted.
contracts.limits: A certificate checker may supply the equivalence hypothesis; this component does not implement such a checker.

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.countAccepted
declarations.summary: The number of accepted elements of a finite witness type.
declarations.type_pp: {W : Type u_1} → [Fintype W] → (W → Bool) → Nat
declarations.type_pp_all: {W : Type u_1} → [Fintype.{u_1} W] → (accept : W → Bool) → Nat

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.countAccepted_eq_card
declarations.summary: The finite indicator sum is exactly the cardinality of accepted witnesses. This semantic theorem is independent of machines and source-specific adapters.
declarations.type_pp:
∀ {W : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype W] (accept : W → Bool),
  Eq (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted accept) (Fintype.card (Subtype fun w => Eq (accept w) Bool.true))
declarations.type_pp_all:
∀ {W : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype.{u_1} W] (accept : W → Bool),
  @Eq.{1} Nat (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{u_1} W inst accept)
    (@Fintype.card.{u_1} (@Subtype.{u_1 + 1} W fun (w : W) => @Eq.{1} Bool (accept w) Bool.true)
      (@Subtype.fintype.{u_1} W (fun (w : W) => @Eq.{1} Bool (accept w) Bool.true)
        (fun (a : W) => instDecidableEqBool (accept a) Bool.true) inst))

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.countAccepted_equiv
declarations.summary: A parsimonious bijection preserves the number of accepted witnesses.
declarations.type_pp:
∀ {W : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype W] [inst_1 : Fintype V] (e : Equiv W V) (accept : V → Bool),
  Eq (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted fun w => accept (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe e w))
    (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted accept)
declarations.type_pp_all:
∀ {W : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype.{u_1} W] [inst_1 : Fintype.{u_2} V] (e : Equiv.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} W V)
  (accept : V → Bool),
  @Eq.{1} Nat
    (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{u_1} W inst fun (w : W) =>
      accept
        (@DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} (Equiv.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} W V) W (fun (x : W) => V)
          (@EquivLike.toFunLike.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} (Equiv.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} W V) W V
            (@Equiv.instEquivLike.{u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} W V))
          e w))
    (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{u_2} V inst_1 accept)

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.countAccepted_product
declarations.summary: Independent conjunction multiplies accepting counts.
declarations.type_pp:
∀ {W : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype W] [inst_1 : Fintype V] (a : W → Bool) (b : V → Bool),
  Eq (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted fun w => (a w.fst).and (b w.snd))
    (instHMul.hMul (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted a) (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted b))
declarations.type_pp_all:
∀ {W : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype.{u_1} W] [inst_1 : Fintype.{u_2} V] (a : W → Bool) (b : V → Bool),
  @Eq.{1} Nat
    (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{max u_1 u_2} (Prod.{u_1, u_2} W V)
      (@instFintypeProd.{u_1, u_2} W V inst inst_1) fun (w : Prod.{u_1, u_2} W V) =>
      Bool.and (a (@Prod.fst.{u_1, u_2} W V w)) (b (@Prod.snd.{u_1, u_2} W V w)))
    (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat) (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{u_1} W inst a)
      (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{u_2} V inst_1 b))

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.countAccepted_ignored_product
declarations.summary: Ignoring an independent witness component multiplies the count by its cardinality. In particular, freely adding bits does not preserve counts.
declarations.type_pp:
∀ {W : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype W] [inst_1 : Fintype V] (accept : W → Bool),
  Eq (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted fun w => accept w.fst)
    (instHMul.hMul (Counting.Foundation.countAccepted accept) (Fintype.card V))
declarations.type_pp_all:
∀ {W : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype.{u_1} W] [inst_1 : Fintype.{u_2} V] (accept : W → Bool),
  @Eq.{1} Nat
    (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{max u_1 u_2} (Prod.{u_1, u_2} W V)
      (@instFintypeProd.{u_1, u_2} W V inst inst_1) fun (w : Prod.{u_1, u_2} W V) =>
      accept (@Prod.fst.{u_1, u_2} W V w))
    (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat)
      (@Counting.Foundation.countAccepted.{u_1} W inst accept) (@Fintype.card.{u_2} V inst_1))

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.witnessCount
declarations.summary: Ordered Boolean witnesses have exactly `n` bits.
declarations.type_pp: Nat → (List Bool → Bool) → Nat
declarations.type_pp_all: (n : Nat) → (accept : List.{0} Bool → Bool) → Nat

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.witnessCount_falsePadding
declarations.summary: Appending a uniquely determined all-false suffix preserves every count, including zero-length witnesses and zero-length padding.
declarations.type_pp:
∀ (n k : Nat) (accept : List Bool → Bool),
  Eq (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount (instHAdd.hAdd n k) (Counting.Foundation.falsePadding n k accept))
    (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount n accept)
declarations.type_pp_all:
∀ (n k : Nat) (accept : List.{0} Bool → Bool),
  @Eq.{1} Nat
    (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) n k)
      (Counting.Foundation.falsePadding n k accept))
    (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount n accept)

declarations.name: Counting.Foundation.witnessCount_ignored_padding
declarations.summary: In contrast, an ignored `k`-bit suffix contributes the factor `2 ^ k`.
declarations.type_pp:
∀ (n k : Nat) (accept : List Bool → Bool),
  Eq (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount (instHAdd.hAdd n k) fun w => accept (List.take n w))
    (instHMul.hMul (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount n accept) (instHPow.hPow 2 k))
declarations.type_pp_all:
∀ (n k : Nat) (accept : List.{0} Bool → Bool),
  @Eq.{1} Nat
    (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) n k)
      fun (w : List.{0} Bool) => accept (@List.take.{0} Bool n w))
    (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul.{0} Nat instMulNat) (Counting.Foundation.witnessCount n accept)
      (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat
        (@instHPow.{0, 0} Nat Nat (@NPow.toPow.{0} Nat (@Monoid.toNPow.{0} Nat Nat.instMonoid)))
        (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 2) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 2))) k))
